# Naren Arulrajah

> Personal brand hub for Naren Arulrajah — healthcare marketing expert, keynote speaker, author, and founder & CEO of Ekwa Marketing. His core philosophy: "Marketing is helping the right customers find you, like you, and choose you." He helps healthcare practices (dental, veterinary, medical aesthetics, ophthalmology) turn marketing into a predictable system for growth.

Naren Arulrajah founded Ekwa Marketing (https://www.ekwa.com/), a healthcare
marketing agency. He co-hosts eight podcasts across healthcare verticals,
has authored six published books on practice marketing and SEO (including
the "Game Over" Google-domination series), and speaks at conferences,
webinars, and on podcasts about SEO, the impact of AI on search and
marketing, healthcare practice growth, and the founder journey.

Two distinct ways to engage:
- Book Naren to speak (keynotes, panels, workshops, podcast guest): /book
- Book a Complimentary Marketing Session with Ekwa Marketing: /msm

## Topics of expertise

- Healthcare practice marketing (find you, like you, choose you)
- Search engine optimization and dominating Google search
- The impact of AI on search and marketing
- Patient acquisition and online reputation management
- The founder journey and building a company that gives back
